Do not 'fix' it by lowering expected.

leanInfraRouteVerdict: NON-HLF ROUTE EXISTS (Lean-feasible). Identity I = E[Σ_c h_c²] = n(3n−1)/2 DECOMPOSES as E[Σ_c content²] + n²  with  E[Σ_c content²] = C(n,2)  (Kerov content second moment, provable from the Jucys–Murphy element Σ X_i² in Z(ℂ[S_n]) — RSK + center-of-group-algebra, NO hook-length FORMULA). The residual E[Σ h² − Σ content²] = n² is the Plancherel mean of an elementary arm/leg/content combination. So the infra needed is: (1) RSK `Σ(f^λ)²=n!` (note: its q-form `Σ d_q²=[n]_q!` is FALSE for n ≥ 2, measured here symbolically, so only the CLASSICAL RSK identity is available), (2) the JM/content second-moment, (3) the single-diagram elementary hook identity `Σ_c h_c = n + Σ_i C(λ_i,2) + Σ_j C(λ'_j,2)` (verified elementary: True) extended to the squared form. The full hook-length FORMULA is NOT required for Identity I — the ledger's 'needs HLF' scope can be narrowed to the content-moment + elementary-hook infra.
